summary: Frontend-only visual/regression pass after the colourful/family-oriented restyle. Tested at 1440px and 390px across public (/, /deals, /join, /gift, /login, /register), admin (/admin), and partner (/business) surfaces. All required data-testids render and are interactive; hero H1 is 'More family fun, for less.'; register H1 is 'Join the family club.'; deals H1 is 'Explore family deals'. Rainbow strip visible on Navbar/BizNavbar/Admin. Launch banner correctly hidden (offer off). No horizontal overflow at 1440 or 390. Hero search navigates to /deals?q=coffee; category chip filter-cafes updates URL to ?category=cafes; deals-reset-btn clears filter. Admin login with test_design_admin@example.com / TestAdmin!1 succeeds (POST /api/auth/login -> 200), Overview renders 8 coloured admin-stat-* cards + launch-offer-settings box, 'NOT SHOWING' pill confirms launch offer off, sidebar 'Overview' highlighted yellow, 'ADMIN' badge visible next to logo (not clipped). /business while logged in as admin renders biz-navbar with purple 'PARTNERS' pill (bg rgb(112,84,203) on white text - good contrast), open-redeem-page-btn, sticker-link (purple Window sticker panel), partner-stats (4 coloured cards: yellow/teal/green/pink). Mobile 390: mobile-bottom-tab-bar visible with active Home pill, nav-mobile-toggle opens full-screen menu, admin-mobile-bar + admin-mobile-toggle present on /admin. Member card 'The Morgans' renders on hero (desktop + mobile) and does not overflow. 42 console errors on public pages are all 401 /api/auth/me and /api/auth/refresh for the anonymous visitor - expected, not a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: The 'member card The Morgans' on the hero does not expose a dedicated data-testid (e.g. member-card-morgans / hero-member-card). It is visually correct but harder to target in regression tests. Non-blocking.

Expected deals filters filter-family and filter-food are not rendered - only filter-all, filter-cafes, filter-kids (plus the others defined in CATEGORIES) are present on /deals. Not a defect per se because the review request said 'etc.', but confirm the CATEGORIES export matches the review-request list if family/food tiles are intended.

Anonymous visits trigger ~42 401 console errors from /api/auth/me + /api/auth/refresh (bootstrap auth probes). Expected but noisy - could suppress by swallowing 401 in the auth bootstrap fetch so the browser console is clean for non-logged-in marketing visitors.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on checked surfaces (home, deals, join, gift, login, register, admin overview, business)

test_credentials: Admin: test_design_admin@example.com / TestAdmin!1 (pre-created by main agent, works).
